Rewrite snippets/gift-registry-items.liquid so it renders a gift registry with correct HTML escaping in both text and attributes. Inputs (all top-level variables; there is no section object): - `registry_name`: string, or null. - `items`: array, never null, possibly empty. Every element is an object that always has all five keys: - `title`: string, never null. - `url`: string, or null. - `note`: string, or null. - `requested`: integer >= 0. - `purchased`: integer >= 0. It may be larger than `requested`. Escaping: every piece of text placed in the output must use the `escape` filter exactly once, whether it goes into element content or an attribute value. This means an input that already contains an entity such as `&` is escaped again and becomes `&`. Do not use `escape_once`. Output (no whitespace or newlines between or around tags): 1.
